relationship.outline: The outline defines course structure. Changes prompt lesson plans, materials, PPTs, and practice to be reviewed.
relationship.teachingCalendar: The teaching calendar derives session candidates from the current outline while preserving manual scheduling. DOCX, PDF, Excel, and CSV exports are derived files from the current revision.
relationship.lessonPlan: A lesson plan is based on the outline and references and becomes the main source for that session's materials, PPT, and practice.
relationship.content: The lesson body is projected from the current course structure and content blocks. It does not need to exist as a disk file; exporting creates a Markdown file.
relationship.material: Materials supplement lesson plans and PPTs and can also be used directly in class or shared with students.
relationship.ppt: Decks are managed by source, so uploaded existing decks are not mixed into the AI-generation update chain.
relationship.pptPending: Choose AI generation or upload an existing deck. Each source follows a different update policy.
relationship.pptGenerated: An AI-generated deck is bound to the session's lesson-plan revision. When the plan changes, the system previews impact before rebuilding confirmed slides.
relationship.pptUploaded: The teacher's existing deck is preserved. The system only maps content and flags staleness; it never rewrites the original without confirmation.
relationship.practice: Practice follows session objectives and knowledge points. Question banks, assignments, and exams are aggregate uses of the same content.
relationship.file: A local file in the course space that can be used as a teaching asset or generation source.
